description: Source code for a graphics benchmarking application comparing TRIANGLE_FAN and TRIANGLES rendering methods using OpenGL ES 2.0. Defines the TriangleFanBenchSample class with methods for initializing, creating vertex buffers, drawing frames, and measuring performance.

classes.name: TriangleFanBenchSample
classes.description: A class that benchmarks rendering performance of triangle fans versus triangles in OpenGL ES 2.0.

methods.name: createVertexBuffers
methods.description: Creates and initializes vertex buffer objects for drawing squares with triangle fans and triangles.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up the shader program, clears background, and initializes vertex buffers and timing variables.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Outputs total rendering times and cleans up resources.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Performs rendering of multiple squares using both TRIANGLE_FAN and TRIANGLES, measures and accumulates frame times.
